[Accelerate Your Job Search with AI](https://www.coursera.org/learn/accelerate-your-job-search-with-ai/home/welcome)   
![][image1]

Hello, and welcome to Accelerate Your Job Search with AI\! 

Throughout the course, Google experts in recruiting, professional development, and hiring will guide you on how to stand out as a strong candidate in your job search. But to ensure a comprehensive and well-rounded understanding of the job market, this course has also been developed in collaboration with a diverse range of seasoned professionals outside of Google. 

You'll hear directly from employers and hiring managers across various industries as they share what makes an applicant stand out. Additionally, experts from leading workforce nonprofits will offer critical insights from their experience supporting a wide range of individuals looking for jobs, providing guidance on navigating career challenges and building resilience. Finally, professionals from educational institutions will share foundational career development principles and address the specific challenges faced by people new to the job market.
